about_the_game:
Game’s Charm Points

Experience the unique appeal of the Manager, only available in this side story, and uncover the secrets of the mansion! Collect clues throughout the story and enjoy a multi-ending system that changes based on your choices!

Characters

Manager
The caretaker of the mysterious otherworldly mansion where the protagonist is summoned. After being unexpectedly dragged into the real world by the protagonist, the Manager reveals an adorable and surprisingly charming side. But what about the dark secrets hidden in her past? What is the Manager really hiding?

Yoon Sarang
One of the maids who was summoned to the mansion along with the protagonist. With her cute looks and kind, caring personality, it's impossible not to fall for her! But… there’s something strange about the look in her eyes...

Story

One day, the protagonist gets hit by a truck and finds themselves in a strange mansion in another world. There, a blue-haired girl introduces herself as the Manager, and four unique maids await. The rules are simple: if you choose one maid, you can return to the real world in three days. But… who should you pick?

Rules are meant to be broken, right? Instead of choosing a maid, the protagonist drags the Manager back to the real world!
“What are you doing, Master?! Who brings the Manager back to the real world?”
With the Manager gone, disaster threatens the mansion. The only way to return her is to uncover the secrets of her past. Will you be able to discover the Manager’s memories and send her back safely?

Controls

  • Left Mouse Click / Enter: Progress the story, select buttons

  • Right Mouse Click: Open menu, skip to next choice

Developer’s Comment

Isekai Maid DLC: Cinderella of the Blue Rose is a spin-off of the original Isekai Maid. For the first time, you can play through the Manager’s route—previously an unromanceable character! For the best experience, we recommend playing the main game before starting this DLC.
